b2.name: CHAPTER 1 REVIEW
b2.sub: Watch chapter 1's battle clips in a real fight: tap PLAY on a clip (or PLAY ALL) and send REDO with a note on what looks wrong. Mudling, Pond Grump, Bog Toad and Log Lump wait on the field.

b2.name: CHAPTER 1 REVIEW: THE BIG ONE
b2.sub: The same review with The Big One on the field: its idle and its attack clips.

b2.name: CLIP TEST: ROSE
b2.sub: Animation test. Pick ATTACK, then Boop: Rose plays her video-made Boop. The Mudling moves on its own.

b2.name: JUSTIN’S TRYOUT
b2.sub: Test fight. Tom, Grace, Rose and Justin, every move unlocked.

b2.name: SOLO
b2.sub: Test fight. Pick anyone, alone, every move unlocked. Nobody can be hurt. Leave with EXIT.

b2.name: OLIVIA’S TRYOUT
b2.sub: Test fight. Tom, Grace, Rose and Olivia, every move unlocked.

b3.name: NEW 1: TWO MUDLINGS
b3.sub: Chapter 1 fight. Two Mudlings in Front.

b3.name: NEW 2: MUDLING AND SKEETER
b3.sub: Chapter 1 fight. A Mudling in Front, a Skeeter Swarm in Back.

b3.name: NEW 3: POND GRUMP AND MUDLING
b3.sub: Chapter 1 fight. A Pond Grump winds up a big Soggy Slap.

b3.name: NEW 4: BOG TOAD AND SKEETER
b3.sub: Chapter 1 fight. A Bog Toad sweeps the whole family with its tongue.

b3.name: NEW 5: LOG LUMP
b3.sub: Chapter 1 Elite. Log Lump has 4 Composure pips and starts braced. A Skeeter Swarm in Back.

b3.name: NEW 6: THE BIG ONE
b3.sub: Chapter 1 boss. 6 Composure pips. It glares at someone, then bites them on its next turn.

b3.name: NEW 7: TNB JOINS (LOG LUMP)
b3.sub: TNB takes Deedee’s place: Ceramicist or Longboarder, with Grace, Tom and Rose. Log Lump has 4 Composure pips.

b3.name: NEW 8: NARA JOINS (TOAD AND SKEETER)
b3.sub: Chapter 2 party: Tom, TNB and Nara. Nara is Attached Pup (Guard Dog in the Pocket). A Bog Toad sweeps the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 9: BOPPY JOINS (BIG ONE)
b3.sub: Chapter 3 party: Tom, Grace, Rose and Boppy. Boppy is The Dep (Pepper Boss in the Pocket). The Big One has 6 Composure pips.

b3.name: NEW 10: AMY, JUSTIN AND OLIVIA (BIG ONE)
b3.sub: Tom with the three grown-ups: Amy is Fitness Queen (Classroom Boss in the Pocket), Justin is Basement Boss (Live Wire in the Pocket), Olivia is Rope Champ (Working Mom in the Pocket). The Big One has 6 Composure pips.

b3.name: NEW 11: TWO SMOGLETS
b3.sub: Chapter 2 fight. Two Smoglets in Front. Brown Haze blinds one of the family.

b3.name: NEW 12: SMOGLET AND TICKET FLURRY
b3.sub: Chapter 2 fight. A Ticket Flurry in Back dodges behind a paper swirl.

b3.name: NEW 13: CANYON COYOTE AND TICKET FLURRY
b3.sub: Chapter 2 fight. A Canyon Coyote howls and the whole pack hits harder.

b3.name: NEW 14: GRIDLOCK AND SMOGLET
b3.sub: Chapter 2 fight. Gridlock winds up Rush Hour, a sweep along the whole floor.

b3.name: NEW 15: TAR PIT BLOB
b3.sub: Chapter 2 Elite. Tar Pit Blob has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Clobber and starts under its Asphalt Crust. A Ticket Flurry in Back.

b3.name: NEW 16: THE BIG SHAKE
b3.sub: Chapter 2 boss. 6 Composure pips. Below half HP it takes Faultline Guard, and Panic Boil! or a Break ends the stance.

b3.name: NEW 17: TWO SOGGY SOCKS
b3.sub: Chapter 3 fight. Two Soggy Socks in Front. They shrug off Drench.

b3.name: NEW 18: BOBBER AND SOGGY SOCK
b3.sub: Chapter 3 fight. A Bobber bobs on the waves and dodges.

b3.name: NEW 19: TANGLE AND BOBBER
b3.sub: Chapter 3 fight. A Tangle winds up a Big Knot.

b3.name: NEW 20: SNAG
b3.sub: Chapter 3 Elite. Snag has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Drench and starts wedged under its Sunken Timber. A Bobber in Back.

b3.name: NEW 21: OLD IRON-GILL
b3.sub: Chapter 3 boss. 6 Composure pips. Every 3rd turn and once at half HP it dives to the Back behind a Soggy Sock and charges Deep Dive.

b3.name: NEW 22: THREE EXTRA EXTRAS
b3.sub: Chapter 4 fight. Three Extra Extras in Front.

b3.name: NEW 23: EXTRA EXTRA AND BOOM MIC MOTH
b3.sub: Chapter 4 fight. The Boom Mic Moth in Back locks Pocket Vibe Skills with Mic Feedback.

b3.name: NEW 24: CLAPPER SNAPPER AND EXTRA EXTRA
b3.sub: Chapter 4 fight. The Clapper Snapper opens with Scene One, Marker!

b3.name: NEW 25: EXTRA EXTRA AND FOG WISP
b3.sub: Chapter 4 fight. The Fog Wisp in Back drenches the family and blinds one of them.

b3.name: NEW 26: CUE CARD CRAB
b3.sub: Chapter 4 Elite. The Cue Card Crab has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Clobber and starts behind its Posterboard Shell. A Boom Mic Moth in Back.

b3.name: NEW 27: THE DIRECTOR’S CUT
b3.sub: Chapter 4 boss. 6 Composure pips. At 60% HP it shouts ACTION! and calls Extra Extras. CUT! stuns and pushes one of the family.

b3.name: NEW 28: TWO POP QUIZZES
b3.sub: Chapter 5 fight. Two Pop Quizzes in Front. Trick Question and Pencils Down! sap Attack and Pep.

b3.name: NEW 29: POP QUIZ AND TARDY BELL
b3.sub: Chapter 5 fight. The Tardy Bell in Back slows and pushes with You’re Late!

b3.name: NEW 30: POP QUIZ AND GLITTER GLUE
b3.sub: Chapter 5 fight. The Glitter Glue in Back pastes the floor and blinds one of the family with a Glitter Burst.

b3.name: NEW 31: DODGEBALL DREAD
b3.sub: Chapter 5 Elite. Dodgeball Dread has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Clobber and starts bouncing (dodges more). A Tardy Bell in Back.

b3.name: NEW 32: THE RED PEN
b3.sub: Chapter 5 boss. 6 Composure pips. At 55% HP it raises Strict Grading: 30% less damage and Points Off on every hit, until a Mix or a Break ends it.

b3.name: NEW 33: TWO ACORN AGENTS
b3.sub: Chapter 6 fight. Two Acorn Agents in Front. Code Red! speeds up one of them.

b3.name: NEW 34: STICKY SAP AND ACORN AGENT
b3.sub: Chapter 6 fight. Sticky Sap drenches and slows, and winds up a Sap Flow over the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 35: ACORN AGENT AND PEANUT GALLERY
b3.sub: Chapter 6 fight. The Peanut Gallery in Back heckles Attack down and winds up a Standing Boo-vation.

b3.name: NEW 36: ACORN AGENT AND TWIG SPY
b3.sub: Chapter 6 fight. The Twig Spy in Back hides in leaf camo and marks the family for more crits.

b3.name: NEW 37: CHEEK STUFFER
b3.sub: Chapter 6 Elite. The Cheek Stuffer has 4 Composure pips and shrugs off Clobber. Snack Snatch takes a Pep and stuffs its cheeks for more Defense. A Peanut Gallery in Back.

b3.name: NEW 38: CHAIRMAN CHEEKS
b3.sub: Chapter 6 boss. 6 Composure pips. Every 3 rounds he calls an Acorn Cache to the Back row and eats it on his 2nd turn after unless the family knocks it out first.

b3.name: NEW 39: DOG-EAR AND SHUSHER
b3.sub: Chapter 7 fight. The Shusher in Back locks a Skill (SHHH!) and winds up a Hush Hour.

b3.name: NEW 40: TWO DOG-EARS
b3.sub: Chapter 7 fight. Page Nip bleeds, Corner Fold lowers Defense, Hard Crease sweeps the Front row.

b3.name: NEW 41: THE CLIFFHANGER AND SHUSHER
b3.sub: Chapter 7 fight. Plot Twist! pushes someone back 20 ticks; To Be Continued... slows the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 42: DOG-EAR AND THE KNOW-IT-ALL
b3.sub: Chapter 7 fight. The Know-It-All lowers Defense and winds up a Well, Technically.

b3.name: NEW 43: POP-UP PANIC
b3.sub: Chapter 7 Elite. Pop-Up Panic has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Racket and starts coiled (+20% Evasion). A Shusher in Back.

b3.name: NEW 44: THE UNREAD
b3.sub: Chapter 7 boss. 7 Composure pips. Below half HP it marks its place (Bookmark Ribbon), then THE END sweeps the whole family and pushes everyone without a shield.

b3.name: NEW 45: TWO LUKEWARMS
b3.sub: Chapter 8 fight. Two Lukewarms in Front. Tepid Slosh and Room Temperature drench, Cold Shoulder slows.

b3.name: NEW 46: LEFTOVER AND LUKEWARM
b3.sub: Chapter 8 fight. The Leftover blinds with Mystery Tupperware and slows the Front row with Freezer Burn.

b3.name: NEW 47: WET BLANKET AND LUKEWARM
b3.sub: Chapter 8 fight. The Wet Blanket lowers Attack with Why Bother? and winds up Dampen Spirits over the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 48: THE DRAFT AND LEFTOVER
b3.sub: Chapter 8 fight. The Draft in Back rides a crosswind (dodges more) and Pilot-Light Gust rips a shield or a buff off one of the family.

b3.name: NEW 49: THE PICKY EATER
b3.sub: Chapter 8 Elite. The Picky Eater has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Clobber and starts behind its Tin Lunchbox Lid. A Draft in Back.

b3.name: NEW 50: OLD IRONBELLY
b3.sub: Chapter 8 boss. 7 Composure pips. BROIL and Full Furnace leave it Toasty: a Drench hit sets off Steam Cloud!. Its Sizzle fires TNB’s clay shields.

b3.name: NEW 51: TWO VELVET ROPES
b3.sub: Chapter 9 fight. Two Velvet Ropes in Front. Members Only gives the Front monsters 15% more Defense and Not On The List pushes someone back.

b3.name: NEW 52: STUFFED SHIRT AND VELVET ROPE
b3.sub: Chapter 9 fight. The Stuffed Shirt lowers Defense with Hmph. and winds up How Gauche! over the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 53: THE HANGER-ON AND VELVET ROPE
b3.sub: Chapter 9 fight. The Hanger-On slows with 1971 Coat Cling and winds up Hang On Tight over the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 54: STUFFED SHIRT AND SORE LOSER
b3.sub: Chapter 9 fight. The Sore Loser in Back bleeds with Card Flick, calls Cheater! to force the family’s aim, and scatters Fifty-Two Pickup.

b3.name: NEW 55: THE WALLFLOWER
b3.sub: Chapter 9 Elite. The Wallflower has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Clobber and starts hugging the wall (dodges more). A Sore Loser in Back.

b3.name: NEW 56: THE MIRRORBALL
b3.sub: Chapter 9 boss. 7 Composure pips. Her own glare leaves her Dazzled: a Clobber hit sets off Shatter Glitz! and a Racket hit sets off Sensory Overload!.

b3.name: NEW 57: TWO CARRY-ONS
b3.sub: Chapter 10 fight. Two Carry-Ons in Front. Overhead Bin Drop lowers Defense and Sizer Frame Check rattles the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 58: CARRY-ON AND JET LAG
b3.sub: Chapter 10 fight. Jet Lag in Back blinds with 3 AM Glare and winds up Three-Hour Time Diff over the whole family.

b3.name: NEW 59: THE LONG LINE AND JET LAG
b3.sub: Chapter 10 fight. The Long Line pushes someone back with Step Back Behind Yellow and winds up Random Screening.

b3.name: NEW 60: THE UNCLAIMED AND CARRY-ON
b3.sub: Chapter 10 fight. The Unclaimed spins, thuds and winds up Excess Baggage on one of the family.

b3.name: NEW 61: THE ARMREST HOG
b3.sub: Chapter 10 Elite. The Armrest Hog has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Sizzle and starts with both armrests claimed. A Jet Lag in Back.

b3.name: NEW 62: THE LAST CALL
b3.sub: Chapter 10 boss. 7 Composure pips. Boarding Group Nine marks a Back-row ally and GATE CLOSED slams them next turn with Skill Lock.

b3.name: NEW 63: THE GREMLINS
b3.sub: Bonus chapter. Three Sprinkle Gremlins in Front, all of them Dazzling with sprinkles.

b3.name: NEW 64: THE CONE HEADS
b3.sub: Bonus chapter. A Gremlin in Front and two Cone Heads in Back. Scoop Pass heals the hurt one, so pick who goes down first.

b3.name: NEW 65: THE SLUSHIE SLUG
b3.sub: Bonus chapter Elite. The Slushie Slug has 4 Composure pips, shrugs off Drench and starts behind its Blue-Ice Glaze. A Cone Head in Back.

b3.name: NEW 66: BRAIN FREEZE
b3.sub: Bonus chapter boss. 6 Composure pips. Below half HP it puts up the Frosted Lid and winds up Deep Freeze.

b3.name: NEW 67: LOST LUGGAGE AND RED-EYE
b3.sub: Chapter 11 fight. Lost Luggage in Front flings socks that lower Defense. Red-Eye in Back yawns, blinds and dims the cabin lights on everyone.

b3.name: NEW 68: THE STANDBY SPRITE
b3.sub: Chapter 11 Elite. The Standby Sprite has 4 Composure pips and starts behind the gate podium. Waitlist Bump pushes one of you back. A Red-Eye in Back.

b3.name: NEW 69: FINAL CALL
b3.sub: Chapter 11 boss. 7 Composure pips. Gate Change trades a Front and a Back ally and pushes both. At 60% HP it calls Lost Luggage and everyone speeds up.

b3.name: NEW 70: GRIDLOCK PRIME
b3.sub: Chapter 12 boss. 7 Composure pips. Four-Way Red Light is a Guard Stance and two buffs and calls a Gridlock, once above and once below half HP. Exhaust Heatwave leaves it Toasty too.

b3.name: NEW 71: THE TUNNEL REGULARS
b3.sub: Chapter 13 Elite. The Turnstile Grump or the Signal Fault in Front has 4 Composure pips and starts braced. A Hushling in Back shushes and tires. Tom, Amy, TNB and Nara.

b3.name: NEW 72: THE DUAL-COAST DRILL WORM
b3.sub: Chapter 13 tunnel boss. 7 Composure pips. A Wired Relay Hushling in Back takes 25% off the Worm while it stands and costs the Worm 2 pips when it falls. At half HP a second one arrives.

b3.name: NEW 73: THE GOLD KNIGHT
b3.sub: Chapter 13 boss. 7 Composure pips. Slow, and nothing pushes him back above half HP. Visor Heat leaves him Toasty. Wide Arms grows from two of you to everyone. Below half HP, Helmet Hum.

b3.name: NEW 74: BOPPY’S GOLD ARMOR
b3.sub: Chapter 14 boss. 8 Composure pips. The family’s hits land on the gold armor, never on Boppy. Nobody pushes him back above half HP. Pepper Breath leaves the armor Toasty and Resting My Eyes is its Guard Stance, so a Racket hit wakes him. Below half HP, the 1970 Cross-Country Story.

b3.name: NEW 75: RETURNING POND PACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14, a Part 1 monster back. The Bog Toad with a Skeeter Swarm behind it, on the chapter 14 stat line. Drawn 25% larger.

b3.name: NEW 76: RETURNING PIER PACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14, a Part 1 monster back. Tangle in Front with a Bobber in Back, on the chapter 14 stat line.

b3.name: NEW 77: RETURNING SCHOOL PACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14, a Part 1 Elite back. Dodgeball Dread (4 Composure pips) with a Tardy Bell in Back.

b3.name: NEW 78: RETURNING LIBRARY PACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14, a Part 1 Elite back. Pop-Up Panic (4 Composure pips) with a Shusher in Back.

b3.name: NEW 79: RETURNING MOON CLUB PACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14, a Part 1 Elite back. The Wallflower (4 Composure pips) with a Sore Loser in Back.

b3.name: NEW 80: RETURNING AIRPORT PACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14, a Part 1 Elite back. The Armrest Hog (4 Composure pips) with a Jet Lag in Back.

b3.name: NEW 81: THE BIG ONE, BACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14 returning boss. The Big One with its Part 1 acts on the gate stat line: 4 Composure pips, about 4 rounds.

b3.name: NEW 82: OLD IRON-GILL, BACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14 returning boss. Old Iron-Gill with its Part 1 acts and a returning Soggy Sock when it dives. 4 Composure pips, about 4 rounds.

b3.name: NEW 83: THE RED PEN, BACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14 returning boss. The Red Pen with its Part 1 acts on the gate stat line: 4 Composure pips, about 4 rounds.

b3.name: NEW 84: THE UNREAD, BACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14 returning boss. The Unread with its Part 1 acts on the gate stat line: 4 Composure pips, about 4 rounds.

b3.name: NEW 85: THE MIRRORBALL, BACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14 returning boss. The Mirrorball with its Part 1 acts on the gate stat line: 4 Composure pips, about 4 rounds.

b3.name: NEW 86: THE LAST CALL, BACK
b3.sub: Chapter 14 returning boss. The Last Call with its Part 1 acts on the gate stat line: 4 Composure pips, about 4 rounds.

b3.name: NEW 87: HUSH-9 FINAL FORM
b3.sub: Chapter 15 boss, the Windowsill Radio. 7 Composure pips. Two Hushling pods in Back: each one you knock out costs it a pip and leaves it Dazzled. Mute Button locks a Skill list. At half HP Dead Air calls the pods back, then Total Silence.

b3.name: NEW 88: TWO GREY NOTES
b3.sub: Chapter 16 normal fight. Two Grey Notes, one in Front and one in Back, 1,000 HP each. Stick Blinds, Flutter makes you Bleed, Fade tires you and strips a buff. Racket and Drench are their Pet Peeves.

b3.name: NEW 89: MARLOWE
b3.sub: Chapter 16 boss (the bestiary’s Square’s Sign). 8 Composure pips, two Grey Notes in Back. Behind the Eclipse takes 30% less damage and bounces 15% of any hit that is not Racket or Drench back at you; Panic Boil! or a Break drops it. Overexposure and, below half HP, Total Eclipse are charged first.

b3.name: NEW 90: CURATOR AND PAUSE SPRITE
b3.sub: Chapter 17 stairs fight. A Curator in Front, a Pause Sprite behind it. The Curator starts with White-Glove Protocol: +25% Defense and a seal that blocks the first debuff you put on it. The Pause Sprite speeds the Curator up.

b3.name: NEW 91: BRASS DESK WEIGHT
b3.sub: Chapter 17 shelf hall fight. A Brass Desk Weight in Front sitting on its heavy brass base (Guard Stance), a Pause Sprite behind it. Hold The Stack is charged first. Clobber and Razzle are its Pet Peeves, Drench washes off.

b3.name: NEW 92: THE TWIN LENSES
b3.sub: Chapter 17 boss. 8 Composure pips. It swaps lens at every round divider and on Rack Focus: Blue can’t stand Sizzle or Clobber, Orange can’t stand Drench or Razzle. Below half HP it calls a Curator and gains Defense, then Contact-Sheet Archive joins its moves.

b3.name: NEW 93: THE STUDIO RIG
b3.sub: Chapter 18 boss. 8 Composure pips, can’t stand Clobber or Racket. Spotlight Lock marks one of you in Back and Big Flash stuns that person next turn: Tom’s Suite Door Slide takes it, a Break cancels it. At half HP it rolls down a backdrop (Guard Stance, Toasty: a Racket hit brings it down), then Every Light On joins its moves.

b3.name: NEW 94: DEAD LETTER
b3.sub: Chapter 19 hall fight. One Elite in Front, 5 Composure pips, can’t stand Clobber or Sizzle. It starts with a Wax-Seal Ward: +20% Defense, and the first debuff you put on it goes back on you. Return To Sender is charged first.

b3.name: NEW 95: RUBBER STAMP
b3.sub: Chapter 19 hall fight. One Elite in Front, 5 Composure pips, can’t stand Clobber or Razzle, shrugs off Drench. It starts braced on the ink pad (Guard Stance: Panic Boil! or a Break ends it). DENIED! is charged first.

b3.name: NEW 96: THE MAIL-CHUTE COURIER
b3.sub: Chapter 19 mini-boss (Lab only: no scene places it yet). A Dead Letter in Front and the Courier perched in Back. It winds up Special Delivery Slam from the Back and lands in Front; Pneumatic Whoosh sends it back with +20% Evasion. A row move or a Break pins it in Front.

b3.name: NEW 97: THE DEAD-LETTER CENSOR
b3.sub: Chapter 19 boss. 8 Composure pips, can’t stand Razzle or Sizzle. From round 2 it stamps REDACTED on the flavor that hurt it most: that flavor does half damage, takes no pips and costs 1 Pep. Rotate flavors. At half HP it calls a Dead Letter and UNDELIVERABLE joins.

b3.name: NEW 98: THE COLLECTOR
b3.sub: Chapter 20 last boss. Three phases: damage past two thirds and one third of its HP is lost, and the next phase starts at once. You pick your four again at each change (the bench is Deedee, Boppy, TNB and Nara). Phase 1 Still Frame: move on the turn bar or take part in a Mix or Detonation before your next turn. Phase 2 sets the Blue and Orange Lens in Back. Phase 3 is a 200-tick Countdown that only a Break stops.
